test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"breaks into".** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Breaks into" **means to forcefully enter or gain access to something.
 
• This phrasal verb is commonly used to describe burglary or theft.
 
• The verb **"break" **is followed by the preposition **"into" **to indicate the location or object that is being accessed.
 
 
• **Example: **The thief broke into the house and stole valuable items.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"breaks to", **is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **"break from", **means to separate or disconnect from something.
